items.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
items.summary: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

items.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
items.summary: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak,

items.title: Crypto for Advisors: Four questions to ask before trusting a crypto exchange
Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge
items.summary: Under existing rules, Sepblac could only suspend accounts when requested by a foreign financial intelligence unit.

items.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
items.summary: The breach exposed client and employee contact information at Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, which said no unauthorized transactions took place.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 26, 2026

items.title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
items.summary: The firm previously estimated it handled 4% of global crypto exchange trading volume and raised $17 million after the FTX collapse.

items.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
items.summary: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

items.title: Nvidia shipment freeze and U.S. chip curbs put AI stocks under pressure
items.summary: U.S. export controls have halted Nvidia server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries and put billions in data centre financing under review.

items.title: New York Attorney General wins $1.4 billion ruling against founders of crypto trading firm NovaTech
items.summary: AWS Mining and NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddie Petion were ordered to pay $1.37 billion after defrauding hundreds of thousands of people, including 11,000 New Yorkers.

items.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
items.summary: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

items.title: ‘Very racist’ Netflix SBF series, BitMart’s $319M shortfall: Asia Express
items.summary: Netflix’s The Altruist has been slammed for its ‘very racist’ portrayal of CZ. BitMart reportedly has a $319.5 million shortfall and just $1.9M in liquid assets.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
items.summary: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
items.summary: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.

items.title: UK is ‘getting it wrong’ on DeFi regulation, says Coinbase
items.summary: Coinbase and Stand With Crypto argue that the FCA’s proposed DeFi rules could leave UK users without regulated access to decentralized finance.

items.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
items.summary: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

items.title: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts
items.summary: A new decree would allow Spain’s financial intelligence unit to suspend crypto accounts, with firms facing fines for noncompliance.

items.title: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’
items.summary: Economist Robin Brooks warned of dire consequences for stocks if the Federal Reserve fails to deliver dovish cues before the FOMC blackout period.

items.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
items.summary: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.

items.title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
items.summary: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.

items.title: What Is Self-Custody? How to Hold Your Own Crypto Keys
items.summary: Self-custody means holding your own crypto instead of trusting an exchange. Here's how it works, the wallets involved and the risks.

items.title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
items.summary: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
items.summary: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

items.title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
items.summary: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

items.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
items.summary: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

items.title: Elon Musk Says ‘Multiplanetary’ SpaceX Could Be Worth $118 Quintillion. Yes, Quintillion
items.summary: The SpaceX founder claims the firm could one day be worth a million times the global economy, as he pledges free shares to American children.

items.title: Cournot Raises $5M to Build AI-Native Oracle for Verifiable Intelligence
items.summary: The startup uses AI to interpret real-world events for onchain apps and agents, recording evidence and reasoning so outcomes can be audited.

items.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody Says Hackers Accessed Client Contact Details
items.summary: The crypto custodian said an unauthorized party accessed some client and staff names and emails, but found no unauthorized transactions.

items.title: Galaxy Research Withdraws Call That Bitcoin's Bear Market Is Over
items.summary: A month after saying Bitcoin had bottomed in June, Galaxy now says a daily close below $58,525 would signal a materially lower low.
